verdict.rationale: The evidence documents Avalara's own official MCP servers, which expose AvaTax tools to external agents. That is the server role and does not transfer to this client-side story. Because Avalara also offers an AI agent (Avi) and conversational queries, consuming third-party MCP servers is a plausible axis for this product, but nothing shows AvaTax or Avi can connect to external MCP servers and use their tools.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
